Specification: single-interruption ITS (segmented regression) on monthly log growth (%), with a post-Jan-2025 dummy; fit by OLS with Newey-West HAC SE, lag 3. Shift matches the published estimate; p-value uses a normal approximation.

5. Sensitivity checks (not on the site)

checkshift_ppsepn_pren_post
linear trend added-36.6720.160.0692321
imputed months dropped-21.4213.360.1091416

Does not reproduce: the site's robustness row (drop imputed months) reports −11.8 pp, p = 0.282, n = 31. This script's drop-imputed sample gives −21.4 pp, p = 0.109, n = 30 (growth is recomputed on the observed months only). The site's exact construction is not documented in the repo, so the discrepancy is unresolved.

Read this before quoting the result. The shift is significant at neither the 5% nor the 10% level in the main specification, and adding a linear trend changes the magnitude substantially. The site's claim of "no detectable break" is consistent with these numbers, but the estimate itself is not robust to specification.
